title: The ancient Buddhist site of Sarnath that has been added to the World Heritage list, in photos
description: Photos show worshipers at Sarnath, an ancient Buddhist site in the northern Indian city of Varanasi where the Buddha delivered his first sermon. The location was added to UNESCO's World Heritage List...
